description: Prompt for repairing a blocked ticket's environment in place (ASS-97), from inside the ticket variation's VM (the grouped engines): never anything on the Mac or a credential; else what the operator must do; ASS-390 AC1: whatever there blocks the blocked step — dependencies, containers, checkouts, caches, generated files, recorded test commands, stale branches — its known fixes examples only, uncommitted work saved aside first, done only when the failing thing re-runs and passes; logs what it found and changed (AC3), cites only what it read (AC7)

input-arguments.name: problem
input-arguments.description: The checked analysis of the block: summary, root cause, evidence, its classification

remediated.description: true when repaired in place and the blocked step re-checked to pass

evidence.description: The commands run and what each showed

ai-feedback-short.description: Repaired: what was done; else what the operator must do — one line, shown on the dashboard

ai-feedback-long.description: What was found, and what was done or must be done
